notes.title: Patch 1.0.2a
notes.content:
We've made a few adjustments, so check out what has changed:

[list]
[*]✔️ 2 items have been added: a Treasures Counter and a Mirror Counter. Both will help you to check your progress to complete the Treasure Hunters achievements and the Dreamy Vision one. You can get them at the Library.
[*]✔️ Mirrors have been rebalanced: now they will recover 20% of the party HP and give you 5 LP instead of 25%/20 LP.
[*]✔️ Minor bugs have been fixed too.
[/list]
Feel free to join [url=https://discord.com/invite/4y4bwRh]Discord[/url] to report any bug you found.

Male Doll Team
